description: Original ST1221 numerical functions remain unchanged in analysis_core.py. Optional bounded per-region scale fitting is implemented in scale_fitting.py; fixed-mode thresholds and FFT peak detection are unchanged.
limits: Bounded low-index HCP/BCC library; other structures are not tested.
Compatibility scores are not phase probabilities.
Fourier support is not phase fraction.
Automatic searches are bounded and not guaranteed global optima.
Two-scale HCP fits have more flexibility; scores are not corrected for the additional parameter.
A zone containing no c-sensitive reflections cannot determine HCP c.

extensions.scale_fitting.py: Automatic uniform scale for HCP/BCC, or independent HCP basal/c reciprocal scales. Same bounded zone library with a wider reflection band for resizing. Automatic bounds 0.85–1.15; fitting is local and affects prediction points only.
